analysis.reasoning: The call is characterized by extreme optimism regarding AI ('Superintelligence') and massive infrastructure expansion. Management is explicitly signaling a period of aggressive capital expenditure (CapEx) and operating expense (OpEx) growth through 2026 to build out compute capacity. While top-line growth and engagement metrics are very strong, the forward guidance is tempered by the warning of significant upward pressure on costs due to depreciation and talent acquisition. Risk disclosure was moderate, focusing primarily on EU regulatory headwinds.
